title: Daily digest: Vijayendra hits back at Hariprasad over  | Telangana CM congratulates archer Chikit | No relief for Hemant Soren in PMLA case
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Vijayendra hits back at Hariprasad over Shikaripura padyatra.
Telangana CM congratulates archer Chikitha for double gold at Asian Games.
No relief for Hemant Soren in PMLA case from Jharkhand HC, next hearing on Oct 20.
bullets_ur: Vijayendra ne Shikaripura padyatra par Hariprasad ko jawab diya.
Telangana CM ne Asian Games mein do gold medal jeetnay par teerandaaz Chikitha ko mubarakbad di.
Jharkhand HC se Hemant Soren ko PMLA case mein koi relief nahi mili, agli sunwai 20 October ko hogi.
